info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Hauyne Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Hauyne Recliner Catalog Management API facilitates the creation of detailed product entries for the Hauyne Recliner. This endpoint allows businesses to enrich their product catalog by adding essential specifications, features, and descriptions. It is designed for developers looking to enhance user experience through comprehensive product information. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems aiming to provide better visibility of their product offerings.

post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create detailed information for a Hauyne recliner. It requires the user to provide necessary details about the recliner, which will then be stored in the system.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the details required to create or update the Hauyne recliner entry. Ensure that all required fields are filled out accurately to successfully complete the operation.

200.description: The request was successfully completed and the response contains the requested details.

CreateCatalogHauyneReclinerDetailRequest.title: Hauyne Recliner Details Request

hauyne_recliner_id.description: The unique identifier for the Hauyne recliner.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person making the request.

quantity.description: The quantity of Hauyne recliners requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority request.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Hauyne recliner.

CreateCatalogHauyneReclinerDetailRequest.description: Schema representing the request body for creating or updating Hauyne recliner details.
